{{Top|leg}}
This '''Star Destroyer task force''' was used in "shock treatment" operations against unruly regions within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
When the first [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] established himself as a de facto warlord, the Empire sent a task force to remove him. Although claiming to conform to the Empire's rule as a loyal subject, the Moff and his ruling sector government officials were captured by a detachment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], tried and executed on the same day.

With other Imperial regions to punish, the majority of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] task force took off again, leaving behind a smaller force to form the basis of a new sector fleet, and a new Moff, [[Nebin Cray]], to run the sector.
